findings.issue: `Lp.ae_norm_le_norm_top` re-proves by hand Mathlib's `ae_le_lpNorm_exponent_top` (Mathlib/MeasureTheory/Function/LpSeminorm/LpNorm.lean:69). TauCeti already turns that lemma into exactly this statement inline at BoundedContinuous.lean:105-106.

summary: The simple-function integration scaffolding (`contentCLM`, `finMeasAdditive_contentCLM`, `integralSimple`, `_apply`, `_piecewise`, `_le`, plus the `comp_toLpTop`/`extendOfNorm_unique` pattern) is a near-verbatim private copy of the one in `Topology/ContinuousMap/Bounded/AddContent.lean` and should be shared; `Lp.ae_norm_le_norm_top` re-derives Mathlib's `ae_le_lpNorm_exponent_top`.
